vibe: Authority, Clarity, Speed, and Technical Precision

rules.heading_scale: fluid text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl maximum for heroes
rules.letter_spacing: tracking-tight for headings > 32px, tracking-[0.2em] for uppercase labels
rules.weights: Use font-light for elegance, font-black for impact. Avoid generic bolding.

rules.neutral_tint: Greys must have a slight cool tint (Zinc scale works well)
rules.contrast: Always maintain WCAG AA minimum. Ensure white text on #FF5A00 meets contrast (use darker shade for hover).
rules.gradients: No full-screen generic gradients. Use subtle grain textures instead.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use border-collapse layout or 1px subtle borders on right/bottom of grid items. No shadows for admin cards.
surfaces.tracking_timeline: The 'Tracing Beam'. Implement a glowing gradient line travelling vertically connecting the timeline dots to show active transport status.
surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant if content scrolls under it: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px inner border.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise/grain texture overlay to the hero section background to remove 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges or minimal rounded-sm (4px max) to maintain a rigid, structural, 'cargo' aesthetic.

layouts_and_grids.marketing_pages: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetric overlapping panels. Ensure ample negative space. Container p-8 to p-12.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_pages: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Use generous Tailwind spacing values. e.g., p-8 to p-16 for containers. Gap-8 to gap-12 for marketing.

components.navigation: Fixed header with solid or glassmorphism background. Do not use fully transparent. Logo, links (Início, Rastrear, Sobre, Contato). Desktop links must be visible.
components.tracking_input_hero: Massive input field, sharp corners, high-contrast 'Rastrear entrega' button. Focus state must ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#FF5A00].
components.timeline_6_steps: Vertical timeline. Steps: 'Pedido recebido', 'Mercadoria coletada', 'Em transporte', 'Chegou à unidade de destino', 'Saiu para entrega', 'Entregue'. Active state dot should pulse with ring animation.
components.dashboard_metrics: 5 semantic cards. Large bold numbers, small supporting labels. Flat design with 1px borders.
components.data_tables: Shadcn based table. Needs search, row actions (Edit/Update/Delete). Left align table data except numerical metrics.
components.toasts: Use Sonner component for all CRUD success/error feedback.

motion.hover_states: Crisp, fast transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-out. Scale buttons slightly -translate-y-[2px].
motion.stagger: List items (like timeline steps or table rows) must enter with a staggered fade-in animation using Framer Motion.

accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'rastrear-button', 'admin-login-submit').
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 for all inputs and buttons.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical duotone or bold weights.

hero_background.description: Cargo truck travelling on highway at sunset. Use with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.

about_warehouse.description: Tall blue metal shelving in warehouse. Use in 'Sobre Nós' section to show logistics capacity.

contact_support.description: Young professional woman with headset. Use for 'Contato' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js/.jsx files) + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI.
DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Convert any Shadcn components to Javascript (.js/.jsx) upon installation.
Implement 'Início', 'Rastrear Pedido', 'Sobre Nós', 'Contato' on the main marketing flow.
Implement an '/admin' route protected by a simple login mock leading to the Dashboard.
Mock the backend with a context or state manager to simulate CRUD operations on 'Entregas' and 'Movimentações'.
Admin Dashboard must have 5 metrics cards: Total, Aguardando coleta, Em transporte, Saiu para entrega, Entregues.
Admin must feature a data table displaying recent deliveries with actions: Visualizar, Editar, Atualizar status, Excluir.
The Tracking Timeline is the star UI element. Use framer-motion for the timeline dots and a vertical line connecting them.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid simplistic gradients and centered blobs.
Do not apply 'transition: all' in global CSS. Use specific properties.
Do not center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Use 2-3x more spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-16) to make the UI look expensive.
Ensure the UI works flawlessly across mobile and desktop. Make inputs thumb-friendly.
Never use placeholder text for images. Use the provided URLs.
